_comment: WSE-3 reference cycle counts for the xkernel-bench suite. Generated by directly compiling and running the upstream Cerebras CSL benchmark bundles (csl-examples/benchmarks/<name>) against the WSE-3 simulator via cslc + cs_python. These are the human-written baselines the agentic framework must STRICTLY REDUCE to score fast_p >= 1.1. See kernels/SPEC_SCHEMA.md and code_translation/REPIVOT_CYCLES.md.

_meta.regeneration_command: see code_translation/REPIVOT_CYCLES.md or examine the upstream commands_wse3.sh per benchmark

Power-Method._note: Re-baselined 2026-06-18 (Workstream A): bench now builds layout_power.csl -> kernel_power.csl; timed window brackets a single on-device f_power(zDim,max_ite) call. cycles_send scales ~linearly with max_ite (~4350 cyc/iter) and reflects on-device compute. Prev 4877 was host-loop instrumentation at max_ite=1, not comparable.

Conjugate-Gradient._note: Re-baselined 2026-06-18 (Workstream A): on-device variant (layout/kernel _conjugate ...), single on-device solve launch in the timed window. Reflects on-device compute. Prev 14958 was host-loop instrumentation.

Preconditioned-CG._note: Re-baselined 2026-06-18 (Workstream A): on-device variant (layout/kernel _preconditioned ...), single on-device solve launch in the timed window. Reflects on-device compute. Prev 17197 was host-loop instrumentation.

BiCGSTAB._note: Re-baselined 2026-06-18 (Workstream A): on-device variant (layout/kernel _bicgstab ...), single on-device solve launch in the timed window. Reflects on-device compute. Prev 25970 was host-loop instrumentation.

SpMV-Hypersparse._note: Upstream ships WSE-2 build only (commands_wse2.sh, --arch wse2). No WSE-3 reference cycles available. For this kernel the agent's target is workflow 2 cycle-reduction WITHOUT a reference comparison: report cycles_send from the agent's first passing variant as the implicit baseline.

_instrumentation_note: The kernels above don't currently print `cycles_send` from their run.py. To make them measurable for the optimizer, instrument their run.py with the same tic()/toc() + time_send pattern used by the cycle-reporting kernels (see csl-examples/benchmarks/power-method/run.py for the canonical pattern). Until instrumented, these are correctness-only kernels. | 2026-08-06: list refreshed. FFT 1D-2D, GEMV Checkerboard, Histogram, Mandelbrot and Single Tile Matvec were instrumented in earlier sessions and are in the active sweep; Laplacian2D-Reduce and LorenzoPredictor-Tile were instrumented and verified this session. Remaining entries are WSE-2-only upstream bundles.
